name: Jujutsu: Zero
creator: Studio Resonance
redeem: Launch Jujutsu: Zero on Roblox and finish the opening tutorial if you have not done it yet.
On the main menu, before you load into the world, click Codes, the fourth option in the list.
Type or paste the code into the Enter Codes Here box in the middle of the screen, matching the capital letters.
Press Redeem to add the Cursed Crystals, Lumens, and Clan Rolls to your account.
notes:
Jujutsu: Zero is an action RPG from Studio Resonance based on the Jujutsu Kaisen anime. You roam an open world, fight cursed spirits and sorcerers, collect cursed objects, and train your cursed technique as you level up. Your clan gives passive bonuses, so many players reroll it hunting for a better one, and later content includes raids and awakenings like the new Awakened Projection.

Codes give Cursed Crystals, Lumens, and Clan Rolls. Clan Rolls are the best reward for most players, since a strong clan helps for the whole game, and the game boosts clan luck on weekends, so saving rolls until then is smart. New codes arrive with each update and whenever the game reaches a like goal, and the developers list the current ones in the game description on Roblox.

faq.q: Why can't I find the Codes button in Jujutsu: Zero?
faq.a: You need to finish the opening tutorial first. After that, Codes is the fourth option on the main menu, which shows up before you load into the world.

faq.q: When is the best time to use Clan Rolls from codes?
faq.a: Try to spend them on a weekend, when the game runs boosted clan luck. You get a better shot at a rare clan from the same number of rolls.

faq.q: Why does CLOUD or 210KLIKES say expired?
faq.a: Jujutsu: Zero usually retires older codes when a new update or like goal code goes live. The Roblox game description always shows the newest codes, so check it if a code fails.

tips: Open the Progression Menu whenever you are not sure what to do next. It was added to keep your quests organized, so it is the easiest way to see your next goal.
Fight cursed spirits as you travel instead of running past them. The world also holds valuable cursed objects, so exploring off the main path is worth your time.
Raids are endgame content. The Zen'in Elite raid is aimed at levels 7,000 to 11,000, so focus on leveling up before you try it.
The game is in beta, but the description says data will not reset. Anything you earn now, including your clan and levels, carries forward.
useRewards: Both active codes give 50 Clan Rolls each, so you get 100 rolls to chase a better clan. Hold on to the Cursed Crystals and Lumens until you know what you want to spend them on, since it is easy to waste currency early in an RPG. The description already teases the next like-goal code, so check back once the game passes its next like milestone.
